payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed NER model utilizes features from cross-lingual wikification, which allows for the recognition of named entities that may not be explicitly listed on Wikipedia by grounding them in categories and types derived from multiple languages.

claims.text: The proposed NER model can recognize named entities not listed on Wikipedia by using cross-lingual wikification techniques.
The model builds on features from multiple languages, enhancing its ability to identify entities beyond those in Wikipedia.
Wikifier features provide strong signals for named entity recognition, improving performance across languages, including those with smaller Wikipedia entries.
